decisions.reason: Glass-silicon wafers with vertical through contacts extend the firm's core competence in structured packaging wafers, fit its stated strategy of multifunctional packaging wafers, and with industry turnover growing there is no performance shortfall that would trigger problemistic search to redirect these resources.

Carrier wafers for handling smaller-diameter wafers are a low-cost extension of the established offer that matches the firm's direction toward reusable carriers and thin-wafer handling, so with performance at or above aspiration management has enough slack to keep it on the market while demand develops.
